title: ScytheMod
description: Scythe Mod adds powerful endgame scythes with unique combat mechanics, active abilities, special right-click skills, HUD timers, custom progression, and dark fantasy-style gameplay for both survival and PvP.
body:
# Scythe Mod

**Scythe Mod** adds powerful endgame scythes with unique combat mechanics, passive effects, active abilities, special projectiles, custom status effects, enchantments, HUD cooldown indicators, progression, and advancement challenges.

This is not just a weapon pack. Every scythe has its own combat role, resource system, strengths, risks, and playstyle for both survival and PvP.

---

## Scythes

### Bloody Scythe

A cursed melee weapon focused on sustained pressure, self-healing, and finishing wounded enemies.

#### Passive mechanics

- Attacks can inflict **Bleeding**.
- Bleeding periodically deals true damage and ignores conventional defenses.
- **Vampirism** gives attacks a chance to restore health.
- Some attacks can partially bypass enemy damage mitigation.
- Supports the exclusive **Spiked Blade** enchantment.

#### Right Click — Blender

Pulls nearby enemies toward the wielder, damages them, slows them, and applies Bleeding.

#### Ability Key — Blood Harvest

Marks nearby enemy players for a limited time.

Killing a marked player during the harvest grants powerful temporary bonuses. Failing to complete the harvest applies negative effects to the wielder.

---

### Toxic Scythe

An anti-armor weapon focused on poison, equipment destruction, and area denial.

#### Passive mechanics

- Basic attacks can damage every equipped armor piece.
- Basic attacks can apply **Poison II**.
- Supports the exclusive **Acidity** enchantment, which increases armor damage caused by Toxic Scythe abilities.

#### Right Click — Toxic Orb

Launches a toxic projectile that explodes on impact.

The explosion:

- deals armor-piercing damage;
- applies Poison;
- damages equipped armor.

#### Ability Key — Toxic Aura

Creates a temporary toxic aura around the wielder.

Enemies inside the aura:

- receive Poison;
- continuously lose armor durability;
- can receive additional armor-piercing damage;
- can be affected by Nausea.

---

### Withering Scythe

A necromantic weapon focused on soul harvesting, summoned minions, and Wither effects.

#### Passive mechanics

- Basic attacks can apply **Wither II**.
- Killing mobs grants souls.
- Killing players grants additional souls.
- Can summon up to **6 minions** by default.
- Supports the exclusive **Additional Slot** enchantment to increase the minion limit.
- Supports the exclusive **Soul Siphon** enchantment for a chance to gain additional souls.

#### Right Click — Summon Minion

Consumes souls and durability to summon a loyal Wither Skeleton minion.

Minions:

- follow their owner;
- defend their owner;
- attack hostile targets;
- can regenerate by consuming durability from the owner's scythe.

#### Shift + Right Click — Dismiss Minions

Dismisses the owner's summoned minions.

#### Ability Key — Withering Aura

Applies Wither to nearby enemies and grants Strength and Speed to summoned minions.

---

### Golden Scythe

A luck-based weapon focused on valuable loot, golden marks, Piglin safety, and high-priority target execution.

#### Passive mechanics

- Grants an additional level of **Looting** while held in either hand.
- The passive Looting bonus does not stack between multiple Golden Scythes.
- Piglins remain neutral while the scythe is held, similarly to wearing golden equipment.
- Enemies can be marked to improve their drops when killed.

#### Right Click — Midas Touch

Damages a target for **50% of its maximum health**, subject to minimum and maximum damage limits.

- If the ability kills the target, it drops loot with increased Looting power.
- If the target survives, it receives a golden mark and still drops improved loot when killed later.

#### Ability Key — Golden Rain

Marks all valid enemies within a large radius.

Marked enemies drop improved loot when killed.

---

### Frost Scythe

A control-oriented weapon focused on freezing enemies, ranged attacks, terrain manipulation, and large-area disruption.

#### Passive — Master of Cold

While the Frost Scythe is present in the player's inventory:

- the player can walk across Powder Snow as if wearing Leather Boots.

While the Frost Scythe is held:

- nearby water freezes similarly to **Frost Walker II**;
- attacks have a **33% chance** to apply Freezing for **1 second**.

#### Right Click — Ice Spike

Consumes **30 durability** and fires an Ice Spike.

- Cooldown: **20 seconds**
- Projectile speed: equal to a fully charged arrow
- Damage: **10**
- Freezing duration: **1.5 seconds**

#### Ability Key — Storm

Consumes **100 durability** and affects all valid targets within **20 blocks**.

- Cooldown: **40 seconds**
- Applies Freezing for **5 seconds**
- Applies Slowness for **10 seconds**
- Applies Weakness for **10 seconds**
- Ignores teammates and tamed creatures

---

## Frozen Heart

The **Frozen Heart** is a rare consumable material used in Frost Scythe progression.

When eaten, it:

- restores hunger similarly to Raw Porkchop;
- can be eaten even at full hunger;
- applies Freezing for **3 seconds**;
- immediately fills the vanilla freezing meter;
- causes the player's health display to become covered in frost, similarly to standing inside Powder Snow.

---

## Custom Status Effects

### Bleeding

A damaging effect associated with the Bloody Scythe.

- Periodically deals true damage.
- Ignores conventional defensive mechanics.

### Freezing

A control effect associated with the Frost Scythe and Frozen Heart.

- Prevents movement.
- Prevents the affected target from turning.
- Has a chance to deal true damage once per second.
- Displays an ice shell around affected entities.

---

## Scythe Combat

Scythes are designed to function as complete primary weapons rather than simple ability activators.

- Scythes perform sword-like sweeping attacks.
- Scythes can receive regular sword enchantments.
- Scythes remain compatible with their own exclusive enchantments.
- Scythe-specific enchantments can only be applied to their intended weapons.
- Active abilities consume durability and have independent cooldowns.
- Ability cooldowns are displayed through the custom HUD.

---

## Enchantments

### Spiked Blade

Exclusive to the **Bloody Scythe**.

- Improves the scythe's offensive pressure.
- Cannot be applied to other scythes.

### Additional Slot

Exclusive to the **Withering Scythe**.

- Level I: **+1 minion**
- Level II: **+2 minions**
- Level III: **+4 minions**

### Soul Siphon

Exclusive to the **Withering Scythe**.

- Has one level.
- Grants a **50% chance** to receive double souls from a kill.

### Acidity

Exclusive to the **Toxic Scythe**.

- Level I: **+11% armor damage**
- Level II: **+22% armor damage**
- Level III: **+33% armor damage**

---

## Controls

- **Right Click** — use the held scythe's special ability.
- **Scythe Ability Key** — use the held scythe's active ability.
- Default ability key: **R**
- **Shift + Right Click** with the Withering Scythe — dismiss summoned minions.
- Hold **Shift** while viewing a scythe tooltip to display detailed ability descriptions.
- Hold **Alt** to display exact numerical characteristics.

Displayed statistics can include:

- damage;
- radius;
- duration;
- durability cost;
- cooldown;
- effect strength.

---

## Progression

The mod includes custom progression based on crafting, rare materials, ability usage, combat mastery, and scythe-specific challenges.

### Materials

- Bloody Essence
- Toxic Essence
- Withering Essence
- Golden Essence
- Frost Essence
- Frozen Heart

### Advancements

Custom advancements are available for:

- obtaining rare materials;
- crafting every scythe;
- eating a Frozen Heart;
- using passive, special, and active abilities;
- applying custom status effects;
- summoning and maintaining Withering Scythe minions;
- harvesting souls;
- mastering Bloody Scythe combat;
- marking enemies with the Golden Scythe;
- using Ice Spike and Storm;
- mastering every scythe.

The Frost Scythe progression branch includes:

- **Frozen**
- **Ice Cream**
- **Frosty Freshness**
- **King in the North**

---

## Compatibility

- Optional **JEI** integration
- English and Russian localization
- Full **Combat Extended** support
- Multiplayer-aware targeting for teammates and tamed creatures

---

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- A compatible Minecraft version listed on the downloaded file
